dedupe_keys.name: supplemental materials for constrained reinforcement learning scheduling for low carbon ies considering p2g ccs coupling and district heating network thermal inertia

description: The deposit provides supplemental equations, training procedures, system parameters, ablation settings and sensitivity results for reinforcement-learning scheduling of an integrated energy system with power-to-gas, carbon capture and heating-network inertia. The provider is Hao, Zhang; Sheng, Lan. Coverage: The metadata identify a study configuration, not a measured geographic network. Its spatial scale, time step and study period are not specified in the record description. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The description is a depositor statement, not independent verification of results or reusable software. File completeness and execution remain untested. For simulation it may support reproducing the described scheduling experiment and its parameter choices. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network modelling. This thematic link does not establish use by the authors.
